strings.opt_cfg_intro: Copy a built-in one and edit it: endpoint, model name, prompt. Leave the placeholders alone.
strings.opt_cfg_requests: One config can chain several requests: the main request goes first, and if it fails the checked fallbacks are tried in order.
strings.opt_fold: Collapse / expand (clicking this row works too)
strings.opt_hist_empty: No records yet (or the count above is set to 0).
strings.opt_img_badge: This one has an image request template, so screenshot translation will use it (direct-image mode)
strings.opt_misc_003: A config is just a request. You decide how the parameters look.
strings.opt_no_rotate: Unchecked means it is skipped during rotation (and during tests)
strings.opt_ph_209: Test text, defaults to Hello, world!
strings.opt_ph_210: Language name or code, e.g. “Cantonese” / YUE
strings.opt_ph_212: Search source, translation, or config name…
strings.opt_set_014: Runs the checked requests in order and stops at the first one that returns a translation (same order as a real translation in the panel).
strings.opt_set_017: Create a config on the left to get started
strings.opt_set_033: Create an OCR config on the left to get started
strings.opt_set_041: show a small dot next to the selection, translate when clicked
strings.opt_set_046: All three shortcuts live on that one page. If one shows “not set” after reloading the extension, set it once there.
strings.opt_set_048: Also support selecting text inside embedded frames (iframes, e.g. some comment boxes and editors). The bridge only reports the selection; the button and panel still exist only once.
strings.opt_set_050: Add “Translate selection with RequestTranslate” (only appears when text is selected)
strings.opt_set_051: Add “Translate the screenshot in the clipboard” (take a system screenshot first, see the OCR tab)
strings.opt_set_052: Add “Translate a screen region” (drag a box on screen to translate it, no system screenshot needed)
strings.opt_set_061: Above 1, the panel shows several results at once so you can see which translates better. In the config list below, click a config to light it up (several can be lit) and right-click to turn it off. With none lit, the currently selected config is used.
strings.opt_set_062: When you pick a new config in the panel
strings.opt_set_063: put it at the bottom (drops the top one)
strings.opt_set_064: put it at the top (drops the bottom one)
strings.opt_set_065: With only 1 result shown, both choices are just a switch, so this only appears when “Results shown in the panel” is above 1. It only affects the ad-hoc combination you pick inside the panel, not the default set on this page.
strings.opt_set_067: Each successful translation leaves a local record (source / translation / which config). It stays in this browser only, is never uploaded, and is not part of exports. Set 0 to record nothing.
strings.opt_set_085: What pops up is the real panel from web pages: same styling, top bar, dragging, and close button, updating live with the width / font size / height / theme above. The text inside is sample content.
strings.opt_set_094: Show the source text in the panel
strings.opt_set_096: Fill in an example: warm eye-friendly
strings.opt_set_106: The backup contains plaintext API keys, so only send it to yourself. Tick “encrypted export” to protect it with a passphrase (AES-GCM). The passphrase is not recoverable, so a lost file stays locked.
strings.opt_set_109: Automatically clears any variable whose name contains “key” so the recipient can put in their own. Keys typed directly inside a request template are not detected, so check before sharing.
strings.opt_set_112: Replaces all current configs, variables, settings, and OCR. Encrypted files ask for the passphrase first.
strings.opt_set_116: Bring back all hidden hint texts
strings.opt_set_120: Keep existing configs (checked ones are added, same names are overwritten); unchecked = replace everything
strings.opt_title_201: Drag the handle on the left up and down, or click the arrows on the right
strings.opt_title_202: Float a panel on the page that is identical to the one on web pages (draggable, close with the cross)
strings.opt_title_203: Fill in a warm eye-friendly palette (you can tweak it)
strings.opt_title_204: Export all configs / variables / settings / OCR into one JSON file (contains plaintext API keys, only send it to yourself)
strings.opt_title_205: When ticked, the export is encrypted with a passphrase (AES-GCM), so sharing it or putting it on cloud storage is safe. The passphrase is not recoverable.
strings.opt_title_206: Generate a config file with keys removed, so the recipient can put in their own
strings.opt_title_207: Restore configs from an exported JSON file (replaces all current configs)
strings.opt_title_208: Clear all translation history, cannot be undone
strings.panel_img_none: No config has an image request template yet. Go to the Configs tab in settings and fill one in for a config that can see images, then it will show up here. Currently using “$1$”
strings.panel_slot_remove: Hide this result (only this time; the default set in settings is untouched)
strings.opt_ui_lang_offline: Could not fetch the language list (offline or blocked), using built-in Chinese.
strings.opt_ui_lang_reset: Switched back to built-in Chinese, reloading…
strings.opt_adapter_note: This request does not use a request template; the translation flow is handled by code inside the extension.
strings.opt_ui_lang_checking: Checking which language packs are available…
strings.opt_ui_lang_none: No usable language packs in the list (none of the files could be fetched).
strings.opt_ui_lang_count_post: languages available; picking one downloads it.
strings.popup_input_ph: Type or paste text to translate (the page selection is filled in automatically)
strings.cmdOcrClipboard: Translate the screenshot in the clipboard
strings.menuOcrClipboard: Translate the screenshot in the clipboard
strings.opt_lang_samehint: The panel's top bar has the same dropdown and the same value, so you can switch language on the fly without coming back here.
strings.opt_tpl_ph: Paste a curl here, or write a raw HTTP message
strings.opt_tpl_hint_text: curl or a raw HTTP message both work. Everything is sent verbatim except the placeholders. JSON cannot contain a bare newline (write \n); escape double quotes as \"; a leading # is a comment.
strings.opt_tpl_hint_ocr: Sent verbatim except the placeholders; the prompt goes directly in the request text, it is not a placeholder. See the chip tooltips above for the three image placeholders. Form-style endpoints like Baidu need {{imageUrlEncoded}} (a + inside base64 must become %2B, otherwise it turns into a space). Use {{apiKey}} for the key instead of hard-coding it.
strings.opt_imgtpl_title: Image request template (optional, click to fill)
strings.opt_imgtpl_ph: Leave empty to reuse the template above for images too
strings.opt_imgtpl_hint:
Once this is filled in (on the main request or any fallback), the config shows up in the OCR tab's image config list. It handles images; the template above keeps handling text. Leave it empty to fall back to the one above.
Write it the multimodal way, for example: {"role":"user","content":[{"type":"image_url","image_url":{"url":"{{image}}"}},{"type":"text","text":"Translate the text in the image into {{target}}, output only the translation"}]}
Inside this template {{text}} is the empty string: with direct image passing the image itself is the source.
strings.opt_path_hint_text: Dots plus indexes, e.g. data.translations[0].translatedText. When empty, common response shapes are tried in turn.
strings.opt_path_hint_ocr: Dots plus indexes, e.g. Baidu's words_result (one object per line, joined into one paragraph). When empty, common response shapes are tried in turn.
strings.opt_need_one_cfg: At least one config must remain.
strings.opt_chip_target: The target language from settings, passed through as-is (for chat models)
strings.opt_chip_targetcode: Mapped to the code the API expects (ZH-HANS / JA), for APIs like DeepL that only accept codes. To switch services, write a #@lang table inside the request text (README has one ready to copy)
strings.opt_chip_image: Image placeholder: the image in direct-image mode (a data URL); in the OCR tab, the screenshot data URL. Empty string for normal translations
strings.opt_chip_imagepart: The image segment (with its leading comma) to put last in the content array; an empty string when there is no image. Using it lets one template translate both text and images
strings.opt_chip_imageb64: Raw base64 (no data: prefix), for APIs that want plain base64
strings.opt_chip_imageurl: Base64 run through URL encoding again (form-style APIs like Baidu need this)
strings.opt_chip_apikey: The apiKey from the Variables tab, shared with translation configs
strings.opt_model_rotate2: Both the test and a real translation start from it and try them in turn
strings.opt_t_undef: Undefined variables (replaced with an empty string):
strings.opt_imgtpl_sep: ====== image request template (used for direct image passing) ======
strings.opt_hint_imgcfg_foot: Lists only configs that have an image request template. Add, edit or remove them in the Configs tab.
strings.opt_hint_ocr_test: With no file selected, just click: it uses the first image in the clipboard (Win + Shift + S, then come back and click). It sends the request template above, the same one used by the right-click menu.
strings.opt_hint_imgcfg_test: With no file selected, just click: it uses the first image in the clipboard (Win + Shift + S, then come back and click). It sends the image request template of the config selected on the left, the same one used by right-click screenshot translation.
strings.opt_hint_ocr_direct: When the model is multimodal, no OCR relay is needed: the screenshot goes straight to the image config selected on the left, skipping the OCR path above. The list on the left only shows configs that have an image request template; if none has one, it falls back to the current config in the top bar (which most likely cannot see images).
strings.opt_hint_vars:
Values defined here can be referenced in request templates with {{name}}, for example writing the API key as Bearer {{apiKey}}. Entries below override built-in variables with the same name.
When a value contains one entry per line (and the template uses a variable holding a model name, such as model / GEMINI_MODEL), translation tries them from the first one and uses whichever returns a result first; a single line is just a normal value.
strings.opt_hint_trigstyle: This is the small button that appears next to the selection; it only affects the button itself. Globe is a line icon whose colour follows the theme; Custom has no base plate — the whole thing is the SVG you paste below.
strings.opt_hint_trigsvg: Paste an <svg>…</svg> here to replace the built-in icon / the character. The base plate still comes from the preset chosen above; pick Custom to control the base plate too. Write currentColor for the colour so it follows the theme.
strings.opt_hint_panelcss:
This CSS is injected into the panel's own shadow root. The panel is not part of the page DOM, so pasting it into Stylus / user.css is no use — it only works here.
Available hooks: #rt-panel (the panel itself; an id selector outranks the presets, usually no need for !important), [data-rt-theme="dark"] and [data-rt-theme="light"] (to target each theme), plus .rt-head .rt-cfg .rt-lang .rt-out .rt-src .rt-slot .rt-slot-h .rt-slot-name .rt-slot-b .rt-acts .rt-act .rt-foot .rt-msg .rt-more .rt-diag .d-k .d-v .rt-btn .rt-dot. These names will not change (aliases would be added instead).
strings.opt_set_028: Disable external OCR (only when the model is multimodal)
strings.opt_tryall: model tried in turn, up to $1$ sends
strings.opt_ocr_intro: “Translate the screenshot in the clipboard” and “Translate a screen region” both first turn the image into text with the config selected here, then hand it to a config for translation.
strings.opt_ocr_direct_intro: Direct image passing is on: the screenshot skips OCR and goes straight to the image request template of the config selected on the left.
strings.adapter_bing_label: Bing translate · free, no API key needed
strings.adapter_bing_hint: Uses the bing.com web endpoint. The first translation fetches the auth parameters (about 0.5s extra); requests within the following hour are fast.
strings.varhint_image: The image in direct-image screenshot mode (a data URL); an empty string for normal translations
strings.varhint_imageb64: Raw base64 (no data: prefix), for APIs that want plain base64
strings.varhint_imageurl: Base64 run through URL encoding again (form-style APIs like Baidu need this)
strings.varhint_imagepart: The image segment (with its leading comma) to put last in the content array; an empty string when there is no image
strings.varhint_target: The target language from settings, passed through as-is (for chat models)
strings.varhint_targetcode: Mapped to the code the API expects (ZH-HANS / JA), for APIs like DeepL that only accept codes. To switch services, edit the #@lang table at the end of the config
strings.varhint_url: The URL of the current page
strings.varhint_title: The title of the current page
strings.opt_hint_trigidle: If the mouse stays still for this many seconds after the button appears, it hides itself (moving the mouse or hovering the button does not count). Set 0 to never auto-hide.
strings.opt_hint_trigleave: After the mouse leaves the button without clicking, it hides after this many seconds; moving back keeps it. Set 0 to disable this.
strings.opt_hint_maxh: Only used when the entry above is set to Auto: once the body reaches this height it stops growing and the rest scrolls. Unit is vh (percent of the window height), default 46; set 0 for no limit.
strings.opt_hint_uilang: Only changes the interface language, not the translation target language. A language pack is about 10-40 KB, fetched from GitHub on demand and not bundled, so it does not grow the extension. If the download fails the current language stays.
strings.trigger_hint_badge: Rounded purple gradient tile with the character in the middle. The default style
strings.trigger_hint_globe: A round base with a line-drawn globe (with meridians)
strings.trigger_hint_custom: No base plate: the SVG you paste is the button itself (the card stays empty until you add one)
strings.opt_ui_lang_same: That is already the current language.
